messages.content: Great! I'm excited to talk with you about enhancing the university student portal. To start, could you share your high-level goals for these new features? What do you hope to achieve with the personalised timetable management, automated grade notifications, and module feedback system?

Yeah, I think the main thing is just to make everything easier to use. Like, I want to be able to see my timetable in a way that makes sense for me, you know? It can be really hard to read sometimes, so if I could colour-code stuff or hide classes that are cancelled, that would be awesome. 

And getting notified when grades come out would be super helpful too. It’s just so stressful waiting around for that. 

Oh, and I think it would be great to have a way to give feedback on modules too. Sometimes things just don’t work, and I’d like to have a chance to say what I think about it. Overall, just making it all more user-friendly would be amazing.

Thank you for sharing those insights! It sounds like you’re looking for a more tailored and user-friendly experience. 

Let’s dig a bit deeper into the personalised timetable management. You mentioned wanting to colour-code your schedule and hide cancelled classes. Can you tell me more about what other specific features you would find helpful in personalising your timetable?

Um, I guess just being able to add my own study blocks would be nice. Sometimes I have to plan my own study time around classes, and it would be easier if I could see that all in one place. 

I’m not sure what else really, just making it look better and work better overall would be great. But yeah, if I could sort of make it my own, that would be really helpful.

That makes a lot of sense! So, to clarify, you’d like to be able to add your own study blocks to the timetable, in addition to colour-coding and hiding cancelled classes. 

Now, shifting to the automated grade notifications, you mentioned that receiving notifications when grades come out would reduce your stress. Can you elaborate on how you envision these notifications? For example, would you prefer them to come via email, push notifications on your phone, or maybe both?

Oh, I think getting them on my phone would be best, like a push notification or something. That way, I wouldn’t have to keep checking my email all the time. But if it could also come through email, that would be okay too, just in case I miss the phone one. I just want to know right away when something new is posted, you know? That would really help with the waiting anxiety!

Got it! So, you’d like to receive push notifications on your phone for grade updates, with the option of also getting an email notification as a backup. That sounds like a great way to stay informed and reduce anxiety.

Now, let’s talk about the module feedback system. You mentioned wanting a way to provide feedback on modules. Can you describe what kind of feedback you would want to give? For instance, would you prefer a simple rating system, open comments, or specific questions to answer?

Hmm, I think a mix would be good. Like, maybe some kind of rating for different parts, like how the module was taught or the resources provided. Then, I’d also like to add comments if I have something specific to say. Sometimes it’s just easier to explain things rather than just giving a number, you know? Just having a chance to share my thoughts would be really important.

That sounds like a solid approach! So, you're looking for a feedback system that combines a rating for various aspects of the module, along with an option for open comments to share your thoughts in more detail. 

To summarize what we've discussed so far:

1. Personalised timetable management with features like colour-coding, hiding cancelled classes, and adding personal study blocks.
2. Automated grade notifications via push notifications on your phone, with email notifications as a backup.
3. A structured module feedback system that includes both a rating system for different aspects of the module and an option for open comments.

Now, before we wrap up, are there any limitations or restrictions you can think of that we should consider for these enhancements?

Um, I haven't really thought about that, to be honest. I just want it to be easy to use and make my life simpler. I guess I trust you guys to figure out what works and what doesn't. As long as it doesn't make things more complicated, I'm good!

That’s completely understandable! Keeping it simple and user-friendly is a key priority. 

Thank you for sharing your thoughts and insights today. Based on our conversation, I have gathered the following requirements:

1. Personalised timetable management with features like colour-coding, hiding cancelled classes, and adding personal study blocks.
2. Automated grade notifications via push notifications on your phone, with email notifications as a backup.
3. A structured module feedback system that includes both a rating system for different aspects of the module and an option for open comments.

If I understand correctly, you want these enhancements to be straightforward and to improve your overall experience without adding complexity. 

I appreciate your input, and I believe we have a solid foundation for these enhancements. Thank you for your time!
